engineered_definitions.Comorbidity_Score: Integer count (0-4) of co-occurring conditions: HighBP + HighChol + HeartDiseaseorAttack + Stroke.
engineered_definitions.Obesity_Flag: Binary indicator for Body Mass Index >= 30.0 (WHO/CDC Class I+ Obesity).
engineered_definitions.Severe_Obesity_Flag: Binary indicator for Body Mass Index >= 35.0 (Class II+ Severe Obesity).
engineered_definitions.Metabolic_Syndrome_Proxy: Co-occurrence of obesity (BMI >= 30), hypertension (HighBP=1), and hyperlipidemia (HighChol=1).
engineered_definitions.Unhealthy_Days_Total: Sum of physically unhealthy and mentally unhealthy days in past 30 days (0-60).
engineered_definitions.High_Risk_Age: Binary indicator for individuals aged 60 and older (Age category >= 9).
engineered_definitions.Socioeconomic_Stress: Joint presence of lower educational attainment (<= Grade 11) and lower household income (<$20,000).
